note: Pettis County (unincorporated) zoning: county Planning & Zoning page says zoning info is 'coming soon' and links no district map or GIS service. City of Sedalia, the largest city, publishes its zoning only as static PDF maps (Zoning-Map-8-7-23.pdf, 2022 map). Sedalia's ArcGIS Hub (sedaliamogis-sedaliagis.hub.arcgis.com) has services for streets, water, parcels and base layers but no queryable zoning district layer. Other ArcGIS 'Zoning' services found in searches (Alaska, Guilford NC, Las Vegas) are not Pettis County's.
